Theorem
[Long time existence---complete with bounded curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0385 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-short-time-existence-complete ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-uniqueness-complete ↗ thm:chow-ii-shi-local-higher-derivative-estimates 1. appD:D.5\group Ricci Flow Existence

In the class of complete solutions with bounded sectional curvature, a complete noncompact initial metric of bounded sectional curvature has a unique maximal Ricci flow on $[0,T)$. If $T<\infty $, then \[ \lim _{t\nearrow T}\sup _{x\in \mathcal M}|\operatorname {Rm}(x,t)|=\infty . \]
